evd_title: GPT-4 correctly detected errors in 7 of 13 constructed short CS papers
finding: GPT-4 correctly detected errors in 7 of 13 constructed short CS papers
P: 13 hand-constructed short CS papers, each with one inserted error
I: GPT-4 via ChatGPT (May 3/12 2023 builds); Prompt-Direct, Prompt-OneShot, Prompt-Parts (sentence at a time); 3 responses each
C: Other prompt strategies; 8 other LLMs (Bard, Vicuna, Koala, Alpaca, LLaMa, Dolly, OpenAssistant, StableLM)
O: Errors detected: Parts 7/13, OneShot 6/13, Direct 5/13, overall 7/13 (53.8%); 2 false alarms; other LLMs 0/13
S: Controlled benchmark on hand-constructed adversarial corpus
T: GPT-4 ChatGPT builds May 3 and May 12 2023; paper 2023
